nodeTypes.name: Repository
nodeTypes.description: A git repository, the anchor for most of the graph.

properties.name: url
properties.description: The git remote, in any form; stored canonicalised as https://host/org/name

properties.name: host
properties.description: Host of the remote, e.g. github.com. Derived from url

properties.name: org
properties.description: Owning organisation or user. Derived from url

properties.name: name
properties.description: Repository name. Derived from url

properties.name: visibility
properties.description: public, private or internal, as the forge reports it

properties.name: packageNames
properties.description: Package names this repository publishes

nodeTypes.name: Team
nodeTypes.description: A group that owns repositories, services or infrastructure.

nodeTypes.name: Service
nodeTypes.description: A running logical component, which may span more than one repository.

properties.name: tier
properties.description: Criticality tier, e.g. gold

nodeTypes.name: Pipeline
nodeTypes.description: A CI/CD workflow definition.

properties.name: provider
properties.description: e.g. github-actions

properties.name: repoKey
properties.description: Key of the repository holding the workflow

properties.name: workflowPath
properties.description: Path of the workflow file

nodeTypes.name: Artifact
nodeTypes.description: A built, addressable output such as a container image.

properties.name: registry
properties.description: e.g. ghcr.io

properties.name: digest
properties.description: Immutable content digest, preferred for identity

nodeTypes.name: Deployment
nodeTypes.description: One event of putting an artifact into an environment.

nodeTypes.name: Environment
nodeTypes.description: A deployment target such as staging or production.

properties.name: tier
properties.description: Criticality, for ranking impact; read as other where absent

nodeTypes.name: CloudResource
nodeTypes.description: An infrastructure object in AWS, Azure or GCP.

properties.name: provider
properties.description: aws, azure or gcp

properties.name: resourceId
properties.description: ARN, Azure resource id or GCP asset name

nodeTypes.name: ConfigurationItem
nodeTypes.description: A configuration item from a service management system such as ServiceNow.

properties.name: sourceSystem
properties.description: e.g. servicenow

properties.name: instance
properties.description: Instance the CI belongs to

properties.name: sysId
properties.description: Identifier in the source system

properties.name: ciClass
properties.description: e.g. cmdb_ci_service

properties.name: operationalStatus
properties.description: As the CMDB reports it, e.g. Operational or Retired

properties.name: businessCriticality
properties.description: e.g. 1 - most critical

properties.name: number
properties.description: The human-facing identifier, where the CI has one

nodeTypes.name: ChangeRequest
nodeTypes.description: A change as a service-management tool records it, with its approval and window.

properties.name: sourceSystem
properties.description: e.g. servicenow

properties.name: number
properties.description: The human-facing identifier, e.g. CHG0001

properties.name: state
properties.description: As the tool reports it, e.g. Implement or Closed

properties.name: startDate
properties.description: Start of the planned window

properties.name: endDate
properties.description: End of the planned window

nodeTypes.name: Incident
nodeTypes.description: An operational failure as a service-management tool records it.

properties.name: sourceSystem
properties.description: e.g. servicenow

properties.name: number
properties.description: The human-facing identifier, e.g. INC0001

nodeTypes.name: Library
nodeTypes.description: A third-party package a repository depends on, as its ecosystem names it.

properties.name: ecosystem
properties.description: npm, maven, pypi, go or gradle

properties.name: name
properties.description: The package name as the manifest spells it

nodeTypes.name: IacFile
nodeTypes.description: An infrastructure-as-code file, and the resources it names.

properties.name: repoKey
properties.description: Key of the repository holding the file

properties.name: path
properties.description: Path within the default branch

properties.name: resourceRefs
properties.description: Identifiers the file names literally, for the link engine to match on

nodeTypes.name: Change
nodeTypes.description: A commit range or merge in a repository, identified there by its head sha.

properties.name: repositoryKey
properties.description: Key of the repository the change was made in, e.g. github.com/acme/payments

properties.name: sha
properties.description: The commit the change ends at, stored in lower case

properties.name: baseSha
properties.description: The commit the change starts from, for a range

properties.name: url
properties.description: Where the change can be read, e.g. the commit or compare page

nodeTypes.name: PullRequest
nodeTypes.description: A proposal to merge a change into a repository, as the forge records it.

properties.name: repositoryKey
properties.description: Key of the repository the pull request targets

properties.name: number
properties.description: The forge's number for it within the repository

properties.name: branch
properties.description: The head branch, e.g. chorus/CH-42-retry-webhook

nodeTypes.name: ExternalWorkItem
nodeTypes.description: A task, ticket or issue in the system that owns it, referred to by its URI.

properties.name: uri
properties.description: e.g. chorus://task/01J... or https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/PAY-42

properties.name: system
properties.description: The system that owns the work item

properties.name: externalKey
properties.description: Its human-facing identifier there, e.g. CH-42

nodeTypes.name: Ontology
nodeTypes.description: Records which ontology version the graph was built with.

nodeTypes.name: SyncRun
nodeTypes.description: One execution of a connector, for auditing what a sync changed.

properties.name: sourceSystem
properties.description: What this run stamped on the provenance of everything it wrote

properties.name: mode
properties.description: FULL, INCREMENTAL or WEBHOOK

properties.name: sourceId
properties.description: The source system's id for the delivery that caused this run

properties.name: status
properties.description: RUNNING, SUCCESS, PARTIAL or FAILED

properties.name: tombstones
properties.description: Facts this run closed because the source stopped reporting them

properties.name: watermark
properties.description: Where the next incremental run should start

nodeTypes.name: ConnectorState
nodeTypes.description: What the graph remembers about a connector between runs.

properties.name: watermark
properties.description: Reported by the last successful run

properties.name: lastRunId
properties.description: The last scheduled or manual run to finish, whatever its status

properties.name: lastStatus
properties.description: That run's status; the same as lastRunStatus, kept for states written before it

properties.name: lastRunStatus
properties.description: SUCCESS, PARTIAL or FAILED

properties.name: lastSuccessAt
properties.description: When the last successful run finished

properties.name: consecutiveFailures
properties.description: Runs that ended PARTIAL or FAILED since the last SUCCESS

nodeTypes.name: ServicePrincipal
nodeTypes.description: A connector or agent registered as a principal of its own, owned by a team.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The client id its tokens carry (azp, or client_id)

properties.name: ownedBy
properties.description: Key of the Team that answers for it; recorded on its writes as onBehalfOfTeam

edgeTypes.name: OWNED_BY
edgeTypes.description: Ownership of a repository, service or cloud resource by a team.

properties.name: pathPatterns
properties.description: CODEOWNERS patterns the owner was named against, where ownership came from a file

edgeTypes.name: OWNS_RESOURCE
edgeTypes.description: A repository or service is responsible for a piece of infrastructure.

properties.name: rule
properties.description: Which link rule proposed this, e.g. tag or iac

edgeTypes.name: DEPENDS_ON
edgeTypes.description: A dependency between repositories, services or third-party libraries.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: What sort of dependency this is

properties.name: manifest
properties.description: File the dependency was read from, e.g. build.gradle.kts

properties.name: version
properties.description: The version the manifest asks for, as written

properties.name: scope
properties.description: Whether the dependency is needed to run or only to build

properties.name: relType
properties.description: The source system's own name for the relationship, e.g. a CMDB's 'Depends on::Used by'

edgeTypes.name: CONTAINS_IAC
edgeTypes.description: A repository holds an infrastructure-as-code file.

edgeTypes.name: HAS_PIPELINE
edgeTypes.description: A repository defines a CI/CD pipeline.

edgeTypes.name: RELATES_TO_CI
edgeTypes.description: A repository or service corresponds to a configuration item in service management.

edgeTypes.name: AFFECTS
edgeTypes.description: A change or an incident concerns a configuration item, service or repository.

edgeTypes.name: CAUSED_BY
edgeTypes.description: An incident is attributed to a change.

edgeTypes.name: BUILT_FROM
edgeTypes.description: An artifact was built from a repository at a particular commit.

edgeTypes.name: DEPLOYED_TO
edgeTypes.description: An artifact was the subject of a deployment.

edgeTypes.name: PROVIDES
edgeTypes.description: A repository provides a running service.

edgeTypes.name: INTRODUCED_IN
edgeTypes.description: A change was made in a repository.

edgeTypes.name: MERGES
edgeTypes.description: A pull request merged a change.

edgeTypes.name: CONTAINS
edgeTypes.description: An artifact was built with a change in it.

edgeTypes.name: IMPLEMENTS
edgeTypes.description: A change implements a work item in the system that owns it.

edgeTypes.name: TRACKED_IN
edgeTypes.description: A work item is tracked by a team.

edgeTypes.name: PRODUCED
edgeTypes.description: A sync run asserted this node.

properties.name: sourceSystem
properties.description: The system of record, one sources.yaml declares: manual, github, servicenow and so on

properties.name: sourceId
properties.description: The fact's identifier in that system, when it has one

properties.name: observedAt
properties.description: When the source says the fact was true

properties.name: confidence
properties.description: 1.0 when reported by the system of record, lower when derived by a rule

properties.name: validTo
properties.description: Set when the fact is superseded

properties.name: writtenBy
properties.description: The subject of the principal that made the write, or a service principal's name

properties.name: principalType
properties.description: The kind of that principal

properties.name: onBehalfOfTeam
properties.description: The key of the Team a service principal acted for; absent for a user

sources.name: manual
sources.description: Stated through the API by the principal that made the write. Needs graph:write only

sources.name: github
sources.description: Repositories, teams, manifests and ownership read from GitHub by the GitHub connector

sources.name: github-actions
sources.description: Pipelines, artifacts and deployments reported by GitHub Actions workflows (POST /api/v1/ingest/deployment)

sources.name: servicenow
sources.description: Configuration items, change requests and incidents read from ServiceNow by the ServiceNow connector

sources.name: aws
sources.description: Cloud resources read from AWS. Declared for the AWS connector; none ships yet

sources.name: dogfood-seed
sources.description: What the dogfood seed job reads from this repository (POST /api/v1/ingest/seed)

sources.name: sdlc-knowledge-graph
sources.description: The graph's record of itself: the sync runs and connector states it keeps
